recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central band portrait set against a warm, draped fabric backdrop, framed by a wide, textured marble-effect border. The design utilizes a 'torn paper' graphic device for the title and a high-contrast 80s fashion palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm, golden-lit portrait contrasted against a cool, off-white marble border
Sharp, jagged black torn-paper element overlapping the soft portrait edge
Tall vertical prop providing a strong diagonal line through the left third of the frame
Triangular arrangement of subjects creating depth and focus on the central seated figure
coreInvariants: Wide marble-textured vertical border on the right side
Torn-edge black rectangle for the primary display text
Warm, directional studio lighting creating soft shadows on draped fabric

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a tiered group; one seated centrally, three standing behind in a staggered formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The seated figure in the lower center, framed by the standing members and the vertical prop.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right title block, moves down the marble border, then sweeps left across the band members' faces following the diagonal of the prop.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the wide marble border on the right and the draped background above the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and gold (background drapes and lighting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright marble border and the dark, moody clothing of the subjects.

composition.position: Top right, overlapping portrait and border
composition.overlap: Placed on top of a black torn-paper shape

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single high-impact condensed face paired with a minimalist geometric logo at the bottom.
graphicDevices: Thin black border lines separating the portrait from the frame

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high x-height profile.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality, though slightly too wide.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a four-person 80s band with big hair and blazers, standing in front of warm gold draped fabric. A tall black cylindrical prop stands on the left. The image is framed on the right by a wide off-white marble texture border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black rectangle with jagged, torn-paper edges in the top right corner. Inside the rectangle, place the title in an ultra-condensed magenta sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the marble border present on the right side?
Does the title block have a torn-paper texture?
Is the font color a vibrant 80s magenta?
Is the lighting on the subjects warm and golden?

adjustableVariables: Degree of 'torn' texture on the black box
Number of band members in the portrait
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the marble texture looks organic and not like a flat gray color.
Check that the torn paper edge looks physically ripped, not just a zigzag line.
Verify the typography is strictly uppercase and vertically elongated.
Confirm the color palette maintains the warm/cool contrast between the center and the border.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Studio Portrait with Draped Backdrop] + [Wide Marble Border on Right] + [Torn Paper Header with Magenta Condensed Type] to achieve this specific 80s new-wave aesthetic.
